characters.name: Noah
characters.description: elderly kind man, about 70-looking, long white beard, bushy white eyebrows, warm brown eyes, olive skin, sturdy build, brown wool robe with a rope belt, cream head-cloth, leather sandals, holds a wooden mallet

characters.name: Naamah
characters.description: Noah's wife, elderly gentle woman, about 65-looking, round kind face with smile lines, warm hazel eyes, olive skin, long moss-green wool dress, cream head-scarf covering all her hair, carries a woven reed basket

characters.name: Noah's Sons
characters.description: three grown sons, about 30-looking, olive skin, short dark beards, simple knee-length tunics in rust-red, sand-yellow and sky-blue with brown belts, sandals; strong and cheerful, usually carrying planks or bundles of hay

characters.name: Dove
characters.description: a small pure-white dove with soft round wings, tiny pink feet, bright black eyes and a gentle friendly look

characters.name: Ark
characters.description: Noah's ark: an enormous long wooden boat-house of honey-brown planks, three decks high, a flat-topped wooden roof, a big ramp door on the side, a small square window near the top, and rows of round portholes along the side

cover.prompt: Noah stands smiling at the bottom of the Ark's wide ramp, one arm open in welcome, as pairs of animals walk up behind him: two elephants, two giraffes ducking their heads, two rabbits hopping, two lions, two parrots on a beam. A bright rainbow arches across a clearing blue sky behind the Ark. Wide shot, warm sunny light, joyful and inviting, Noah as the main focus.

pages.prompt: A sunny field beside a small village of stone houses. Noah kneels on a long wooden beam, raising his wooden mallet to tap in a peg, tongue poking out in concentration, wood shavings around him. Behind him the first ribs of the huge Ark rise like a giant wooden skeleton. Medium shot, bright morning light, cheerful working mood.

A small group of village neighbors in simple robes stands near the half-built Ark, pointing up and laughing with their hands on their bellies. Noah stands calmly in front of them with his mallet, answering with a patient, gentle smile and one finger raised toward the clear sky. Medium-wide shot, bright midday light, the unfinished Ark towering behind.

A passage of time: Noah and his three sons lifting and hammering planks high on wooden scaffolding, the Ark now almost finished and tall as a hill. Sunset sky, piles of planks and pegs on the ground, Noah wiping his brow with a satisfied smile. Wide shot from low on the ground looking up at the enormous Ark, warm orange light.

The animals arrive at the Ark's big open ramp door: two elephants stomping up the ramp, two rabbits hopping beside them, and two tall giraffes bending their long necks low to fit through the door, looking a bit silly. Noah stands at the side of the ramp with his mallet, laughing and waving them in. Wide shot, golden afternoon light, playful mood.

A long cheerful parade of animal pairs going up the ramp: lions, tiny ants in a line, green frogs, bright parrots. At the end Noah, Naamah and their three sons walk up last, Naamah carrying her basket. Gray clouds gather in the sky, and the great door is swinging shut by itself, edged with a soft warm glow. Wide shot, dramatic but safe light.

A cozy cross-section view: outside, heavy silver rain pours down over dark waves around the Ark. Inside, warm lamplight glows; animals snuggle in hay, Naamah wraps a blanket around a sleepy lamb, and Noah looks out the small window at the rain with a calm smile. Medium-wide shot, contrast of cool blue rain outside and warm golden light inside.

Inside the Ark's lower deck, lit by oil lamps: busy feeding time. Noah carries an armful of hay to two cows, one of his sons pours seeds for a row of birds on a perch, and a big lion waits politely beside a large wooden bowl. Medium shot at the animals' eye level, warm golden lamplight, wooden beams and stalls.

Night inside the Ark: a cat and a little mouse sleep curled up side by side on a pile of hay, perfectly friendly. Around them other animals doze, a lamp glows low, and raindrops streak the small window. Close-up on the cat and mouse, soft dim golden light, very peaceful and sleepy.

The rain has stopped. Noah leans out of the Ark's small open window high above calm water, gently releasing the white Dove from his hands into a pale clearing sky. His face is hopeful, eyebrows raised. Medium shot from outside the Ark, soft gray-blue morning light with the first gaps of sun in the clouds.

Evening at the window: the Dove flutters back to Noah holding a small fresh green olive leaf in her beak. Noah cups his hands to receive her, face bright with joy. Behind him inside, animals jump and dance: a monkey claps, a rabbit leaps, an elephant raises its trunk. Close-up on Noah and the Dove, warm sunset light.

The Ark rests on a green mountainside on dry land. Animals pour out happily: elephants stepping down the ramp, rabbits bouncing in the grass, birds flying high into the blue sky. Noah, Naamah and their sons stand on the ramp smiling, faces turned to the warm sun. Wide shot, bright fresh morning light, puddles sparkling.

A huge, vivid rainbow arches across the whole sky above the mountain and the resting Ark. Noah and his family stand on the grass looking up in wonder, Noah's hand raised to shade his eyes, the Dove on his shoulder. Animals gather around them looking up too. Wide shot from behind the family, soft glowing light after rain, no figure in the sky.

Noah sits on a rock on the green hillside in the warm sunset, a little rabbit in his lap and a young lamb leaning against his knee, his wooden mallet resting beside him. A soft rainbow still glows faintly in the sky behind. He smiles gently down at the animals. Medium close-up, warm loving mood, golden light.
